ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white central lobe regions bounded by low-intensity black trailing edges and distal tips. Multiple discrete, low-intensity circular blobs (spots) are distributed across the white field: three prominent spots on the left lobe and three on the right lobe, with a large, high-texture low-intensity mass on the far right distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the central lobe junction, calculated at approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal axis of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations with pixel amplitudes varying from 5 to 20 pixels deep along the entire trailing edge boundary, peaking in complexity at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edges of both lobes, transitioning to a sharp interior angle at the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Six distinct, roughly circular low-intensity pixel clusters isolated on the white ventral surface: a trio on the left lobe and a staggered trio on the central-to-upper region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two thin, unaligned linear low-intensity pixel disruptions visible on the lower-middle quadrant of the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular contour loss and high-texture pixel clustering on the right distal tip, indicating major trauma or extensive parasitic colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique constellation of isolated black focal spots on an otherwise predominantly white ventral field.
